integrity: Self-contained proof with exact algebraic comparisons and an executable independent-angular-integration diagnostic. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth embedded circular ring tori, 0<minor radius<major radius; two independent area-uniform surface samples, Euclidean chord distances and population moments. Three consecutive even moments reconstruct geometry; no universal assertion for arbitrary pairs of even moments, nonstandard torus embeddings or finite noisy measurements. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp two-moment ambiguity and three-moment reconstruction of ring-torus surfaces
